title: Boston Marathon — race home page (130th and 131st editions)
claims: The site presents the 131st Boston Marathon presented by Bank of America as the next edition and states that the event represents 130 years of marathon history.
30,000 participants will race on Patriots' Day.
The event is supported by nearly 10,000 volunteers from start to finish.
US$57.3 million has been raised through the Bank of America Official Charity Program.
The page states that 130 years of marathon history are represented.
33,656 qualifier applications were received for the 2027 Boston Marathon.
Qualifier acceptances for the 131st Boston Marathon were announced on 29 September 2026.
